items.headline: Average DAM (Southern proxy) MCP: Rs 2168.57/MWh
items.detail: Day-ahead market average clearing price for 2026-05-03 was Rs 2168.57/MWh across 96 15-min blocks (range Rs 99.58-4500.39/MWh).

raw_values.region_note: Karnataka has no standalone day-ahead price; this uses the IEX Southern-region area clearing price as a proxy (see scope-note.md).

items.headline: Peak-hour (18:00-24:00) MCP premium: +71.1% vs daily avg
items.detail: Peak-hour average MCP was Rs 3710.21/MWh vs the day's overall average of Rs 2168.57/MWh, a +71.1% divergence.

raw_values.region_note: Karnataka has no standalone day-ahead price; this uses the IEX Southern-region area clearing price as a proxy (see scope-note.md).

items.headline: Wide intraday MCP spread: 203% of daily average
items.detail: Max-min spread of Rs 4500.39 - Rs 99.58 = 203% of the daily average, indicating high intraday volatility.
